name: Original City / Fountain District
coordinateNote: One source unit remains one game metre. Source local (X,Y,Z) becomes (192-X,Y-baseY,Z-384). No placed model is rearranged or rescaled. Bounds restrict play; render crop extends16m beyond each playable edge.
indexing: row-major: row=floor((z-originZ)/cell), column=floor((x-originX)/cell), index=row*cols+column; samples at grid vertices.

heightSource.resampling: bilinear original height field at one-metre vertices

floorHeightNote: heights is original TerrainData plus original near-street upward-facing mesh floors <=2.4m above the source street datum; terrainHeights is unchanged TerrainData. Visible original floor meshes remain at their original coordinates above the terrain mesh.
